0022600032.text: The Lakers host the Trail Blazers in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with Los Angeles at 6-2 overall, 4-1 at home, and first in the Pacific, and both teams riding two-game winning streaks. Portland comes in at 5-1, 4-0 on the road, and first in the Northwest, while the Lakers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 136-129 loss in Los Angeles on October 27, following a 1-2 series loss to Portland in 2025-26. Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation, and Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery).
